prompt: I have 30+ Figma frames for every possible state of every screen. My developer says this is overkill for AI-assisted development. Is he right? How should I restructure my Figma work?

assertions.text: Confirms that 30+ frames is excessive for AI-assisted development
Explains that AI can generate state variations from a few key screens
Recommends which 5-8 screens to keep as the style guide
Teaches how to let AI handle state variations and responsive layouts
Helps restructure the Figma workflow to be minimal and effective
